create_vardict: create a VarDict instance with variable names and per-variable state counts for probabilistic inference
get_variable_by_name: get a variable hash and state count from a VarDict by variable name using bracket notation
flatten_structured_data: flatten a mapping of variable names to arrays into a single JAX array for internal use
unflatten_flat_data: unflatten a flat JAX array back into a dictionary of per-variable arrays with per_state control
validate_num_states_shape: validate that num_states is a scalar integer or a matching numpy array of integers
